## 4.0-S6b (Tier-3 complete)

- **Representation:** a record is a *map with an annotation* (per Issue 1979/PR 2566) — `XdmMap.RecordType`/`WithRecordType` in Core, no new item kind, map ops/serialization/providers unchanged; 3.1 behavior bit-identical (field checks are annotation-gated).
- **Type syntax:** `record(*)`/`record()`/`record(\x22field\x22 as T?, …)` — string-literal field names, trailing comma, duplicate fields XPST0021; XPST0003 in 3.1 mode. `instance of` exact-entry-count with covariant field subtyping; plain maps never match a record type.
- **Coercion/cast:** §3.4.2 rule 10 (missing → `()` entries, surplus XPTY0004, recursive coercion); §4.19.2.7 cast (keep-or-cast FORG0001, surplus discarded, `record(*)` assertion); function-argument conversion intercept; `?*`/`map:*` stay field-blind per spec.
- **`but with`:** use-last merge + re-coercion to the LHS record annotation (plain-map LHS → XPTY0004); chains.
- **Flagged:** qt4tests `prod/RecordType.xml` is stale (pre-annotation draft) — hand-written tests gate this slice. Nominative records stay deferred.

## Gates

- Build 0 errors; unit **all green** (Api 276 incl. +30 RecordTypeTests, +13 gate tests); QT3 **exactly 31,142/0/679**; XSLT smoke 162/0/26
- **Full XSLT sweeps by the parent before merge — Core/Parser/Compiler/Runtime touched.**

Docs synced: FEATURE_REQUESTS (S6b row), INTEGRATION §0, AGENT_HANDOVER sixty-second session, dossier §4.
